title: SHL’s Groundbreaking Neurodiversity Research Recognized By Genius Within CIC
text:
Press Release
SHL’s Groundbreaking Neurodiversity Research Recognized By Genius Within CIC
Company’s inclusive assessment program scoops Innovation and Ideas Award for 2024
London, UK – Sept. 25, 2024
SHL
, a global leader in talent insights, is proud to announce that it has been named a winner of the prestigious Innovation and Ideas 2024 award from
Genius Within
. This accolade, part of the Celebrating Neurodiversity Awards, honors SHL’s pioneering contributions to
Assessing Neurodiverse Talent in the Workplace
as part of its Inclusive Assessment program.
Recognizing individuals and organizations for going above and beyond to promote accessibility and inclusion, Genius Within, a renowned UK-based social enterprise that champions neuroinclusion through coaching, training and innovative digital products, holds an annual awards program to celebrate successes in the Neurodivergent community.
This year, SHL was recognized for continuing to advance meaningful research into the
assessment experience for Neurodivergent individuals
to help employers improve how they hire, develop and mobilize people.
"Our research highlights the business case for embracing Neurodiversity but also provides practical strategies for organizations to create more inclusive environments," said Sara Guttierrez, Chief Science Officer at SHL. "This award from Genius Within is a testament to the impact of our research in driving meaningful change and empowering Neurodivergent individuals to thrive in their careers. We are honored to be recognized for our work and remain dedicated to advancing the conversation around inclusion in the workplace."
Jacqui Wallis, CEO Genius Within said “We are delighted to be celebrating the work of SHL through these Awards, shining a light on the strengths and positive value that diverse workplaces add to the rich fabric of our world. We celebrate them, and all the other winners across all of the seven categories at the Celebrating Neurodiversity Awards. We share a collectiven ambition; to positively shape a more neuro-inclusive world”
SHL’s neurodiversity research is a cornerstone of the company’s broader Inclusive Assessment program that underpins its
Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI)
initiatives. Through comprehensive studies and data-driven insights, SHL strives to shed light on the unique experience, challenges and opportunities faced by people in underrepresented groups, to identify and break down the barriers that cause inequity in processes across the employee lifecycle.
The award was presented to SHL at the Celebrating Neurodiversity Awards ceremony, which took place on September 25, 2024, at Adobe’s offices in Shoreditch, London.
For more information on SHL’s solutions, innovative research from SHL Labs and its impact, please visit
shl.com

About SHL
SHL, the global leader in Talent Insight, transforms businesses by leveraging the power of people, science, and technology. Our unrivaled, scientifically backed workforce data and highly validated talent solutions provide organizations with the insights needed to optimally leverage their people’s potential and maximize business outcomes. We equip recruiters and leaders with people insights at an organization, team, and individual level, accelerating growth, decision-making, and
talent mobility
and inspiring an inclusive culture that supports game-changing agility. For more information, visit
About Genius Within
Genius Within is a social enterprise dedicated to the empowerment and inclusion of neurodivergent individuals. Through a range of services including coaching, training, assessments, and the innovation of a digital platform, the Genius Finder, they support individuals, businesses, and communities.
Genius Within understand what works, because 63% of their team identify as neurodivergent, disabled (or both), and that lived experience is under pinned by thousands of data points gleaned from research, and experience with clients. This means that they deliver balanced, co-produced services which uniquely combine a wide breadth of lived experience as well as exceptional professional expertise. For more information visit
geniuswithin.org
